earnings.title: 3Q 2026 Earnings Release
highlights: Reported EPS of $3.72 , or $4.23 adjusted EPS
Reached 44 consecutive years of increases in annual dividends per share, longer streak than 95% of S&P 500
Declared a fourth-quarter dividend of $1.07 per share, payable on December 10, 2026, to shareholders of record
